name: regression
description: Regression suite for the trickier retrieval patterns - supersede, contradiction handling, time-decay, and cross-bucket linking. Run alongside smoke.json. The smoke set verifies retrieval works; this set verifies retrieval handles edge cases the keeper introduces over time.

questions.question: What's the current state of our vector-search infrastructure?
questions.notes: Tests that an older superseded decision (if any) is correctly skipped and only the current canonical decision is returned. If a 'we chose Pinecone' memory existed and was later superseded by the Postgres decision, only the Postgres one should surface.

questions.question: What did the keeper flag as contradictory about our database direction?
questions.notes: When contradiction detection flags two memories as conflicting, the bundle should surface BOTH so the human can resolve. This is a structural test - confirms the contradiction-pair retrieval path.

questions.question: What's our durable position on vector search vendors?
questions.notes: Decision memories shouldn't decay - they're permanent until superseded. Tests that an old decision still ranks high when explicitly queried, even if no recent reinforcement.

questions.question: What random benchmark numbers have we seen recently?
questions.notes: Observations decay 90d. After decay, an old observation shouldn't be returned for a vague query. (Pin the eval date forward to 2026-09-01 to test the decay window.)

questions.question: Give me the latest update on DPDP compliance work.
questions.notes: When a summary exists that subsumes N observation memories, the bundle should prefer the summary (token-efficient) over the underlying observations. Tests summary preference in the bundle ranking.

questions.question: Which decisions did our LLM vendor's pricing influence?
questions.notes: Cross-bucket linking - decisions linked to an entity memory should surface together. Tests the entity-graph traversal feature (P1 in PRD).

questions.question: What memories are tagged 'p0' or 'security'?
questions.notes: Tag-filter query. Tests that hybrid search ranks tag-matches alongside FTS+semantic, and that the keeper-applied tags are searchable.

questions.question: Walk me through the full DPDP erasure cascade implementation.
questions.notes: Tests that long-body memories aren't truncated below their natural breaking points when returned in a bundle. The keeper chunks long bodies; this verifies chunk reassembly.
